scope: Downloaded only official small demo arrays, one small GT log and two original author figures. No model weights or dataset archive; no model inference.

transform.verification: Official demo applies estimated transform to source; dataset convention is ref = src @ R.T + t. Supplied GT is exactly equal to benchmark redkitchen gt.log entry [0, 6, 60].

scene_identification.evidence_level: Exact 4x4 GT matrix match to the named benchmark pair. Point arrays were not independently compared against a full scene archive.
scene_identification.interpretation: Use as a real paired point-cloud/GT example; do not label it a 3DLoMatch example. The associated GeoTransformer overlap field is about 35%, not the custom nearest-neighbor statistic below.

overlap_visualization.definition: A point is green if nearest Euclidean distance to any point in the other cloud, after GT alignment, is < 0.1 m. Both directions are computed independently.

rendering.projection: orthographic; identical view matrix and image bounds in all five panels
rendering.geometry_changes: None beyond the given GT transform for aligned panels. All points retained; no invented surfaces. Local normal estimates control point-color shading only.
